note: Close to the textbook case on four of five criteria. He runs research labs across an academic institution in Houston — not a business owner or physician, but squarely within 'or equivalent' as a senior professional. Health is unambiguously the neglected area rather than a crisis: desk-bound since COVID, no diagnosis, no medication, and he describes himself as 'being proactive'. He is not deconditioned — 8,000 to 12,000 steps a day — and he wants good to great rather than rescue. Income is the miss, and it is material: he named two certifications at 3K-4K each plus September travel as direct competition for the money and said he needed time to be sure he would not be 'outstretched at the end of four or five months'. That is a nominally successful professional with constrained discretionary liquidity, which is exactly the population the ICP's income screen filters out and the payment plan is designed to carry. Judged on the criteria rather than on the outcome, he is edge and would move to core if a structure had been offered.
